svg.title: b6-promote-then-agent-revises
svg.desc: b6-promote-then-agent-revises: 12 steps over 10 days from 2026-07-01 (decision open: pins current behaviour). Actors: a1 (agent, claude-code), h (human, alice). a curated source is revised through the tool channel and keeps its trust. 1. [0d] a1 ingest # Settlement schedule → $v1; expects 3 things. 2. a1 remember Card settlements pay out on the second business day after c… → $f1. 3. [1d] h promote $v1; expects 1 thing. 4. a1 search card settlements paid out business day after capture; expects 2 things. 5. a1 forget $v1; expects 2 things. 6. [10d] a1 ingest # Settlement schedule → $v2; expects 4 things. 7. a1 search card settlements paid out business day after capture; expects 4 things. 8. a1 search settlements paid out after capture; expects 2 things. 9. h history $v1; expects 6 things. 10. h search card settlements paid out business day after capture; expects 2 things. 11. h lint payments; expects 2 things. 12. h facts payments; expects 2 things.
